elements.name: Eidetic Memory
elements.desc: When you cast this spell, you remember everything you've ever read or heard in the past. This grants you a +10 bonus when making Intelligence checks for the duration.
elements.mat: a string tied in a knot

elements.name: Hod’s Gift
elements.desc:
The target gains blindsight to a range of 60 feet.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the duration is increased by 1 hour for every slot above 5th level.
